comment: sc-10b seeded bugs (Lean, the only product language this item changes). Each was planted alone in the final lean/VE/Readings/SoftSup.lean; `lake build VE.Readings.SoftSupExamples` was run, the failing proof or #guard is recorded, and the file was restored. M3 was run twice: as planted (supX_pull's proof fails), and again with supX_pull's proof stubbed for that run only, so that the examples file elaborates and the #guards it breaks are listed. Line numbers are of the files at the commit that adds this file.
